Name: Better Jukebox
Author: Gaphodil
TagLine: Improves the Mini-Jukebox and Saloon's jukebox interfaces. Also includes optional settings to change the list of tracks, in-menu or permanently.
Description:
Redesigns the menu that pops up when you use either the jukebox in the Saloon or a Mini-Jukebox.  
Also includes optional settings to change the list of tracks, in-menu or permanently.  

**Install**  
1.  Install [the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).  
2.  Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.  
3.  Run the game using SMAPI.  

**How to use**  
The mod replaces the jukebox menu with a scrollable list. Click a song listing to select it and either click a second time or click on the play button to play the song. The Mini-Jukebox also features a stop button and a randomize button.   
Buttons along the left side allow you to change the sorted order of the list.  
You can optionally [edit the mod settings](https://github.com/Gaphodil/BetterJukebox#configure) to:  
*   include non-music tracks that are normally hidden by the game  
*   include regular and unused songs without needing to hear them in-game  
*   disable menu to use the above setting with the normal jukebox  
and more.  

**Known Issues**  
Mods that add music may not be compatible.  

**See also**  
*   [Release notes](https://github.com/Gaphodil/BetterJukebox/blob/master/release-notes.md)  
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Gaphodil/BetterJukebox)  
*   [Planned features](https://github.com/Gaphodil/BetterJukebox/blob/master/planned-features.md)
